message.content:
Sure! If you're looking for something engaging and well‑crafted, I’d suggest **“Arrival” (2016)** directed by Denis Villeneuve.

**Why it’s worth watching**

| Aspect | Details |
|--------|---------|
| Genre | Science‑fiction / Drama |
| Runtime | ~116 minutes – long enough to immerse but not too exhausting |
| Language | English (with subtitles available) |
| Plot Hook | A linguist is recruited to communicate with extraterrestrials after mysterious spacecraft land worldwide. It blends mystery, emotional depth, and philosophical questions about time and communication. |
| Why it fits “longer than an hour” | At almost two hours, it gives ample room for character development and world building without feeling rushed. |

If you’re interested in exploring more sci‑fi dramas or want another option, let me know your preferences—genre, tone, etc.—and I can tailor further suggestions!
